title: Mysterious Hands at Table
description: A person sees three colored hands reaching over a wooden table covered in papers with painted marks and runes. The blue hand from the top left holds a torn paper, the purple hand at bottom holds a drawing compass, and the golden hand on the right holds a coin over another paper, all around a glowing glass orb with a black rose inside.
